controlled_if_any: content is regulated, contractual, security-sensitive, privacy-sensitive, safety-sensitive, or policy-governed
release is enterprise-wide or external with material consequence
automation, live integration, privileged access, or production deployment is included
source authority is contested or material uncertainty remains
errors are hard to detect, difficult to reverse, or could materially harm people or operations
fast_track_only_if_all: governing sources are complete and current
no material policy, process, interface, audience, or accessibility change exists
asset scope is simple and acceptance criteria are known
independent review and release authority are available

lanes.independence: independent second look required; role transition recorded when one person fills multiple roles
independent content and quality review proportional to risk

lanes.record_depth: full traceability, evidence, authorization, regression, and lifecycle package
lanes.independence: named independent reviewer and authenticated human authority required
